claim_comment: Defining and enforcing the initial upstream patch budget, narrow provider-neutral touch points, zero-touch exception zones, dependency directions, and the bidirectional convergence-map contract.
acceptance_criteria: Every exception requires an ADR and convergence-map entry.
A quantitative initial patch budget is stated.
close_reason: Established and executable-validated the initial upstream patch-footprint budget, allowed provider mounts, forbidden zones and dependencies, and mandatory ADR-backed convergence tracking.
close_comment: Evidence: product/upstream/patch-footprint-policy.json defines seven narrow touch-point categories, five zero-touch exception zones, six forbidden dependency-direction rules, and hard caps of 12 existing upstream production files, 6 upstream test/fixture files, 900 total changed lines, and 180 lines per upstream file. product/upstream/convergence-map.json is the bidirectional ledger and currently proves zero Zack-owned existing-file edits. scripts/product/check-patch-footprint-policy.py validates the immutable PR #707 floor, actual git numstat footprint, per-category and global budgets, convergence-map completeness, ADR evidence, generated-output rules, and Cargo dependency directions; tests/product_patch_footprint_policy_test.py covers budget loosening, broad path hiding, missing touch/dependency rules, floor drift, snapshot drift, orphan entries, incomplete exceptions, stale paths, duplicates, and ADR requirement removal.
